disclaimer: Reference ranges are general adult values. Individual laboratory reference intervals may differ based on equipment, methodology, and population. These ranges are provided for educational purposes only.

tests.plain_description: Hemoglobin is the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen around your body.
tests.fallback_low: A hemoglobin level below the typical range can be associated with anemia, which may cause fatigue or weakness. Many factors can affect hemoglobin. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A hemoglobin level above the typical range can be associated with dehydration or other conditions. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: White blood cells are part of your immune system and help your body fight infections.
tests.fallback_low: A white blood cell count below the typical range can be associated with reduced infection-fighting ability. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A white blood cell count above the typical range can be associated with infection or inflammation. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Platelets are tiny blood cells that help your blood clot when you are injured.
tests.fallback_low: A platelet count below the typical range can be associated with an increased risk of bruising or bleeding. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A platelet count above the typical range can be associated with clotting concerns. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Fasting glucose measures the amount of sugar in your blood after not eating for at least 8 hours.
tests.fallback_low: A fasting glucose level below the typical range may indicate low blood sugar. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A fasting glucose level above the typical range can be associated with prediabetes or blood sugar regulation concerns. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: HbA1c reflects your average blood sugar level over the past 2-3 months and is used to monitor blood sugar control.
tests.fallback_high: An HbA1c above the typical range can be associated with elevated average blood sugar. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Total cholesterol measures the overall amount of cholesterol in your blood, which can affect heart health.
tests.fallback_high: A total cholesterol level above the typical range can be associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular concerns. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: LDL (low-density lipoprotein) is sometimes called 'bad' cholesterol because high levels can build up in arteries.
tests.fallback_high: An LDL cholesterol level above the typical range can be associated with cardiovascular health concerns. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: HDL (high-density lipoprotein) is sometimes called 'good' cholesterol because it helps remove other types of cholesterol from your arteries.
tests.fallback_low: An HDL cholesterol level below the typical range can be associated with reduced cardiovascular protection. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Triglycerides are a type of fat found in your blood; high levels can affect heart health.
tests.fallback_high: A triglyceride level above the typical range can be associated with cardiovascular and metabolic concerns. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Creatinine is a waste product filtered by your kidneys; levels can reflect how well your kidneys are working.
tests.fallback_low: A creatinine level below the typical range can be associated with reduced muscle mass. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A creatinine level above the typical range can be associated with kidney function concerns. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: TSH is produced by the pituitary gland and tells the thyroid how much thyroid hormone to make.
tests.fallback_low: A TSH level below the typical range can be associated with an overactive thyroid. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A TSH level above the typical range can be associated with an underactive thyroid. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: ALT is an enzyme found mainly in the liver; elevated levels can indicate liver stress or damage.
tests.fallback_low: An ALT level below the typical range is generally not a concern but may warrant discussion with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: An ALT level above the typical range can be associated with liver stress. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Vitamin D helps your body absorb calcium and supports bone, muscle, and immune health.
tests.fallback_low: A vitamin D level below the typical range can be associated with reduced bone and immune support. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A vitamin D level above the typical range can be associated with too much vitamin D supplement intake. Please discuss this result with your doctor.

tests.plain_description: Ferritin is a protein that stores iron in your body; its level reflects your iron stores.
tests.fallback_low: A ferritin level below the typical range can be associated with low iron stores. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
tests.fallback_high: A ferritin level above the typical range can be associated with iron overload or inflammation. Please discuss this result with your doctor.
